thread:
maria: hey team, just joined today! trying to get staging Console access and a service account to run a quick local smoke test. stuck at the access form with a 403. who do i ping? :wave:

infra-bot: Access helper: please complete https://redwood.internal/onboard-access. If you see 403, it usually means auto-grouping hasn't applied yet. Expected response time: 4-8h.

kyle: welcome maria! :tada: pinging people-ops to check provisioning. in the meantime, post the project id and flag or endpoint you need access to.

maria: thanks! project is `content-reco-staging`, need ff toggle `reco.v2_canary` + sa to hit staging/infer.

people-ops: adding maria to `console-staging-users` now. provisioning may take a few minutes.

infra-bot: New onboard ticket INC-49822 created for maria. Assigned to infra-onboard.

kyle: once group lands i'll pre-approve a short JIT for `ff-admin` for 6h so you can flip the flag. do you need a long-lived key?

maria: just a 6h key is fine. prefer vault path storage.

people-ops: group membership updated for maria.

infra-bot: JIT request generated: JIT-90177 for maria, role `ff-admin`, note: "validate reco.v2_canary smoke tests". Awaiting approval.

kyle: approved JIT. creating SA key now with roles: `inference.invoker`, `logging.writer`. TTL=6h.

kyle: vault secret created at `secret/data/onboard/maria/sa-key`. rotation policy applied.

maria: got the vault path and can access it, and the JIT window is open. flipping the flag now to run tests. thanks everyone! :rocket:

infra-bot: Audit: JIT-90177 activated by kyle for maria. Toggle activity logged.

maria: tests passed locally. i'll open a small PR to add flag metadata (owner + experiment link) to infra/feature-flags. who should i tag for review?

kyle: tag `@platform-flag-owners` and cc me. i'll review the PR.

maria: will do. super helpful folks, appreciate the fast turnaround :smile:
